surfaces.label: Login
surfaces.purpose: Sign in to the Axiom console — local Basic auth, SSO (OIDC/SAML), or lab demo helper.
operate: Open `https://<host>:30590/` and accept the self-signed certificate once if needed.
Sign-in is two steps: enter a username and **Continue**, then enter the password and **Sign in**. Use **Not you?** on the password screen to go back and change the username.
When SSO is off, click **Lab mode — fill demo** to fill both fields and jump straight to the password screen (lab default `demo` / `demo`).
Or enter operator credentials from Secret `zyvor-axiom-auth` / `AXIOM_USERNAME`+`AXIOM_PASSWORD`.
When SSO is configured, use the OIDC/SAML buttons (public client + PKCE) on the first screen instead.
**Empty / fail:** Sign in failed toast → check credentials / SSO redirect URI `/api/v1/auth/oidc/callback`; health: `curl -k https://<host>:30590/api/v1/health`.
**Success:** Redirect to **Overview**; cluster switcher and sidebar appear.

surfaces.label: Getting Started
surfaces.purpose: Live setup checklist — integration status and first tasks after sign-in.
operate: Open `/getting-started` after first login.
Walk the checklist; items reflect live Atlas/OIDC/PacketWolf/Haven status.
Jump from incomplete items into Settings → Integrations or the related center.
**Empty / fail:** Checklist stale → refresh; viewer role can read but cannot complete mutating setup.
**Success:** Critical integrations green; you can run a workload or open Overview confidently.

surfaces.label: Overview
surfaces.purpose: Cluster pulse — capacity metrics, activity, and shortcuts into day-2 centers.
operate: Land on `/overview` after sign-in (or click Overview).
Confirm cluster name/metrics and recent activity load.
Use the sidebar cluster switcher when multiple clusters are configured (demo mode ships three).
Jump to Nodes / Workloads / Alerts from shortcuts or ⌘K.
**Empty / fail:** Metrics blank → API unreachable or wrong activated cluster; re-login.
**Success:** Cluster headline + cards match `kubectl` reality (or demo fixtures).

surfaces.label: Nodes
surfaces.purpose: Kubernetes node inventory — Ready state, capacity, and entry into node detail.
operate: Open `/nodes` and wait for the table.
Filter/search; open a row → `/nodes/:name` for taints, conditions, capacity.
On detail: **Add taint** when draining or isolating capacity.
**Empty / fail:** No nodes → cluster API / RBAC; demo mode should still show fixtures.
**Success:** Ready nodes listed; detail matches cluster state.

surfaces.label: Node detail
surfaces.purpose: Single-node conditions, capacity, taints, and related workloads.
operate: Open a node from `/nodes`.
Review conditions and capacity; add/remove taints as needed.
Correlate NotReady with Events and Pods.
**Empty / fail:** 404 → stale name; permission errors → ClusterRole.
**Success:** Taint/condition changes reflect after refresh.

surfaces.label: Workloads
surfaces.purpose: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets — scale, restart, seal, rollout, and Run workload wizard.
operate: Open `/workloads`.
**Run workload** — Form / Intent / YAML tabs → submit.
Row menu: Start / Stop / Restart / Scale / Seal / Unseal / Delete / Rollout (pause, resume, undo).
Open detail `/workloads/:ns/:kind/:name` for pods, events, YAML.
**Empty / fail:** Viewer gets 403 on mutate; empty list → wrong namespace filter or fresh cluster.
**Success:** New Deployment appears; scale/restart toasts succeed.

surfaces.label: Workload detail
surfaces.purpose: Single controller — owned pods, events, labels, rollout, raw YAML.
operate: Open a workload from the list.
Inspect owned Pods and Events; use lifecycle actions from the page.
Edit YAML carefully — Save uses server-side apply where offered.
**Empty / fail:** Missing pods → check selectors / Events.
**Success:** Desired replicas match Ready; rollout history coherent.

surfaces.label: Jobs & CronJobs
surfaces.purpose: Batch Jobs and CronJobs — trigger runs, inspect status, delete.
operate: Open `/jobs`.
On CronJobs: **Run now** to trigger; delete retired jobs/cronjobs from row actions.
Confirm Job pods under Pods / Logs.
**Empty / fail:** No CronJobs → create via Apply YAML or workload wizard.
**Success:** Triggered Job appears with completions.

surfaces.label: Pods
surfaces.purpose: Pod inventory across namespaces — phase, restarts, entry into pod detail.
operate: Open `/pods`; filter by namespace/status.
Open `/pods/:ns/:name` for specs, metrics, terminal, YAML.
Use scheduling-diagnosis banner when not Running.
**Empty / fail:** Empty → broaden namespace; CrashLoop → Logs + Events.
**Success:** Running pods listed; detail terminal connects (HTTPS / token).

surfaces.label: Pod detail
surfaces.purpose: Container specs, metrics, multi-tab PTY terminal, manifest Save, port Open.
operate: Open a pod from `/pods`.
Read resources/env/probes; Metrics tab for CPU/memory sparklines.
Terminal: open sessions (multi-tab WebSocket); demo falls back to one-shot exec.
YAML tab → **Save** (server-side apply); Open buttons for container ports.
**Empty / fail:** Terminal blocked → auth/token on WS; Save 403 → viewer role.
**Success:** Shell prompt or metrics stream; Save toast OK.

surfaces.label: Platform Intents
surfaces.purpose: Intent-driven placement / platform requests surfaced in the console.
operate: Open `/platform-intents`.
Review intent cards/status; create via Workloads → Run → Intent when offered.
**Empty / fail:** No intents → submit one from the wizard.
**Success:** Intent progresses to a concrete workload.

surfaces.label: Networking · Cilium
surfaces.purpose: Service graph, NetworkPolicies, and live PacketWolf flows when configured.
operate: Open `/networking`.
Inspect service graph / Cilium summary.
NetworkPolicies: **Create via YAML** (ApplyManifest) or Delete rows.
When `AXIOM_PACKETWOLF_URL` is set, read the live eBPF flow panel.
**Empty / fail:** No flows → PacketWolf unreachable; policies empty → create first.
**Success:** Graph + policies match cluster; seal on a workload shows isolation.

surfaces.label: Services
surfaces.purpose: Kubernetes Service inventory and endpoints overview.
operate: Open `/services`; filter by namespace.
Open a row for ports/selectors; correlate with Ingresses and Pods.
**Empty / fail:** No services → deploy a workload first.
**Success:** ClusterIP/NodePort/LB entries listed.

surfaces.label: Ingresses
surfaces.purpose: Ingress and Gateway API exposure inventory.
operate: Open `/ingresses`.
Review host/path rules and Gateway API section when present.
**Empty / fail:** No ingresses → install ingress controller / apply manifests.
**Success:** Hosts listed match customer DNS expectations.

surfaces.label: Namespaces
surfaces.purpose: Namespace inventory — create and delete tenancy boundaries.
operate: Open `/namespaces`.
**Create namespace** → name → Create; Delete from row actions (confirm).
**Empty / fail:** 403 → viewer; delete blocked if resources remain.
**Success:** Namespace appears in filters across Workloads/Pods.

surfaces.label: Virtual Machines
surfaces.purpose: KubeVirt VM inventory and day-2 actions in the Axiom console.
operate: Open `/vms`.
Filter and open VMs; use lifecycle actions the page exposes (start/stop when available).
Confirm KubeVirt is installed if the list stays empty on a real cluster.
**Empty / fail:** No VMs → install KubeVirt or use demo fixtures.
**Success:** VM phases update after power actions.

surfaces.label: Storage
surfaces.purpose: PVC / storage class intelligence for the connected cluster.
operate: Open `/storage`.
Review PVCs/StorageClasses; note bound vs pending.
Cross-link to Atlas for intent-backed provisioning.
**Empty / fail:** Pending PVCs → check provisioner / Atlas.
**Success:** Bound volumes listed for workloads.

surfaces.label: Atlas
surfaces.purpose: Atlas storage control-plane panel — backends, pools, volumes, buckets, policies.
operate: Wire Atlas under **Settings → Integrations** (URL + token) or deploy with `--with-atlas`.
Open `/atlas` — backends/pools should load when connected.
**Create volume** for a smoke provision; review buckets/policies tables.
**Empty / fail:** Connection failed → Test connection in Settings; token/RBAC.
**Success:** Volume appears; Storage page reflects new PVC if bound into k8s.

surfaces.label: Pod Logs
surfaces.purpose: Stream and inspect pod/container logs from the console.
operate: Open `/logs`.
Select namespace/pod/container; stream or fetch recent lines.
Correlate with Events and Pod detail when diagnosing CrashLoop.
**Empty / fail:** No lines → wrong container / pod gone; 403 → RBAC logs.
**Success:** Live or recent log text for the selected container.

surfaces.label: Events
surfaces.purpose: Kubernetes warning/normal events stream for triage.
operate: Open `/events`.
Filter by type/namespace; open related object links when present.
**Empty / fail:** Quiet cluster is OK; missing events → API watch issue.
**Success:** Recent warnings explain Pending/Failed pods.

surfaces.label: ConfigMaps
surfaces.purpose: ConfigMap inventory — create, edit keys, delete.
operate: Open `/configmaps`.
**Create ConfigMap** — add keys → Create; delete retired maps.
**Empty / fail:** 403 on mutate → viewer role.
**Success:** ConfigMap listed and mountable by workloads.

surfaces.label: Secrets
surfaces.purpose: Secret inventory — create typed secrets, add keys, delete.
operate: Open `/secrets`.
**Create secret** — type + keys → Create; treat values as sensitive in UI.
**Empty / fail:** ClusterRole must allow secrets write in scope used by Users/Integrations.
**Success:** Secret available to workloads; delete cleans up.

surfaces.label: Quotas & Limits
surfaces.purpose: ResourceQuotas, LimitRanges, PDBs, PriorityClasses.
operate: Open `/quotas`.
Review quota / limit range / PDB / priority class tables.
Adjust via YAML apply when the UI does not offer inline edit.
**Empty / fail:** No quotas → create for multi-tenant namespaces.
**Success:** Hard limits visible; workload create respects them.

surfaces.label: Autoscaling
surfaces.purpose: Horizontal Pod Autoscalers — create and delete.
operate: Open `/autoscaling`.
**Create autoscaler** — pick workload + min/max/CPU target → Create.
Delete retired HPAs from the table.
**Empty / fail:** metrics-server missing → HPA cannot compute.
**Success:** HPA listed; replicas move under load.

surfaces.label: Custom Resources
surfaces.purpose: Browse CRD kinds and list custom resource instances.
operate: Open `/custom-resources`.
Select a kind; inspect instance table.
**Empty / fail:** No CRDs → expected on minimal clusters; install operators as needed.
**Success:** Instances for installed operators appear.

surfaces.label: Backups
surfaces.purpose: Volume snapshots, Velero backups, and schedules.
operate: Open `/backups`.
**Create snapshot** for a PVC; **Restore** into a new PVC name when offered.
Velero: create schedules / list backups when Velero is installed.
**Empty / fail:** Snapshot class missing → install CSI snapshotter; Velero empty → install Velero.
**Success:** Snapshot/backup row appears; restore binds a PVC.

surfaces.label: Alerts
surfaces.purpose: Alert inventory and webhook-driven notifications.
operate: Open `/alerts`.
Review firing/open alerts; configure webhooks under Settings when available.
**Empty / fail:** No alerts → healthy or integrations not wired.
**Success:** Alert rows match monitoring rules / webhooks.

surfaces.label: Ops hub
surfaces.purpose: Day-2 ops tabs — GitOps/Helm/RBAC/Identity and related operator tools.
operate: Open `/ops` and switch tabs as labeled in the UI.
RBAC: **New Role** / **New RoleBinding**; Sync where offered.
Identity tab: Haven/Keycloak health when installed.
**Empty / fail:** Tab empty → optional component not installed.
**Success:** Sync/create toasts succeed; RBAC objects listed.

surfaces.label: Users
surfaces.purpose: Local user accounts with admin or viewer roles.
operate: Open `/users` (admin).
Create users with admin/viewer; viewers read-only on mutating APIs.
**Empty / fail:** Persistence needs `zyvor-axiom-users` Secret in production.
**Success:** New user can sign in with the assigned role.

surfaces.label: Settings
surfaces.purpose: Integrations, clusters, theme, and console configuration.
operate: Open `/settings`.
Integrations: Atlas URL/token → Save → Test connection; OIDC/SAML; PacketWolf.
Clusters: review activated cluster label (`AXIOM_CLUSTER_NAME`).
Theme toggle via shell control.
**Empty / fail:** Test connection failed → network/token; OIDC redirect URI must be `https://<host>:30590/api/v1/auth/oidc/callback`.
**Success:** Integration cards healthy; Atlas/Networking panels populate.
